title: GOF seizes 1.2 tonnes of suspected smuggled rice in Tumpat
summary: KOTA BARU: The General Operations Force (GOF) seized 1,216kg of various brands of rice suspected to have been smuggled from Thailand during a raid in Kampung Kubang Panjang, Tumpat, yesterday.
